manifest.name: @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper
manifest.description: Android SDK, emulator and device management plus Kotlin/Compose build-and-run tools for DeepSeek Harness, ported from the official ZCode android-emulator plugin, with its parameter page on the plugin's own detail page in the Plugins panel.

scripts.check: node --test test/*.test.js && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-mount.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit

bundle.text:
# dsh bundle patch for @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper.
#
# This file is the `dsh.bundle.patch` layer of the package. Installing the
# plugin through the official CLI —
#
#   dsh plugin --profile <name> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper
#
# — reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles` against the installed packages and, seeing
# this declaration, appends this package to the bundle stack. Profile boot then
# merges THIS patch, which mounts exactly one host row.
#
# The row id doubles as the settings namespace: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`
# keys every editable form by the profile entry id, and the browser half
# watches that same id through `ctx.configForms.whileServed([...])`. Renaming
# the id here therefore requires renaming `SETTINGS_NAMESPACE` in
# `lib/settings.js` and `lib/client.js` together.
#
# Mounting this package twice (for example by adding the row to the profile's
# own cordis.patch.yml while the bundle channel is also active) registers the
# same tool names twice and fails loudly at the loader. Use one channel only.
- insert:
    - id: android-emulator-helper
      name: '@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper'

readme.text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper)
[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) native port of the official ZCode `android-emulator@0.1.0` plugin: all 23 original MCP tools preserved as native DSH tools, plus a **parameter page on the plugin's own detail page** in the Plugins panel (Plugins → Installed plugins → Android Emulator Helper) that edits the SDK, emulator, system-image, build and output parameters in-app instead of through environment variables.

- Tool and argument names are identical to the original, so workflows written for its `android_emulator` MCP server keep working; the port adds no tool and drops none.
- 17 settings fields in 5 groups, all live-editable; the seven fields the original exposed still fall back to their `ANDROID_PLUGIN_*` variable, then to the built-in default.
- The default AVD is picked from a dropdown of the AVDs on this machine that still have their payload: AVD discovery scans the AVD directory (`ANDROID_AVD_HOME`, then `$ANDROID_USER_HOME/avd`, then `~/.android/avd`) as well as asking `emulator -list-avds`, so the list survives a host where the emulator cannot be started.
- `android_preflight` and the parameter page's **Run diagnostic** button run the same checks — SDK, `adb`, `emulator`, AVDs, JDK, Gradle — and print a fix for each failure.
- Published as `@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper`; the plugin page shows **Android Emulator Helper** / **Android 模拟器助手** from `locale/` rather than the raw package name, and both descriptions say the plugin is unofficial and not affiliated with Google.

On a machine with an Android SDK, a JDK and DSH installed:

1. **Install the plugin**

```bash
   dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper
   ```

In DSH Desktop, open **Plugins** and add the same package name there. Reload or restart DSH afterwards.

2. **Check the machine** — open **Plugins → Installed plugins → Android Emulator Helper** and press **Run diagnostic**. It runs exactly the checks `android_preflight` runs, and prints a fix for anything missing.

3. **Use it** — ask for what you want ("build and run this project on the emulator", "screenshot the running app"), or call the 23 `android_*` tools directly. Everything the tools need is editable on that page.

| Dependency | Notes |
|---|---|
| Android SDK | `sdkPath` on the plugin's configuration page, else `ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`, the Windows registry, the project's `local.properties`, then the common install paths on every drive. |
| Platform tools, emulator and a system image | `adb` and `emulator` come from the SDK; an AVD needs a system image for the API level you target. When `adb` is missing from `PATH`, the SDK's own `platform-tools` copy is used instead: a last-resort search looks for it inside the SDK the diagnostic found, and on Windows also under the drive roots, because a machine with the SDK installed must not be reported as having no `adb`. |
| JDK | `jdkMajor` (`17` by default) selects the JDK a build runs on; the nearest installed JDK is used when that major is missing, and the generated project's JVM target follows the JDK in use and is clamped to [17, 21]. |
| Gradle | `android_build_app` uses the project's `./gradlew` when it has one and `gradle` from `PATH` otherwise; a generated wrapper is pinned to the installed Gradle's version but never below **8.9**, the floor the bundled Android Gradle Plugin 8.7.3 accepts. The project `android_create_app` writes sh
`android_preflight` checks every item above and prints a fix for each failure; the plugin page's **Run diagnostic** button runs the same checks.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper
```

**DSH Desktop**: the `desktop` profile belongs to the Electron app — open **Plugins**, add `@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper` there, and enable the row it creates. After a reload or restart, open **Plugins → Installed plugins → Android Emulator Helper**: the parameter form is on that plugin's detail page, and only appears while the host half actually serves this plugin's settings namespace.

The published tarball contains everything the plugin needs — the host half, the browser bundle, the bundled skill and the `locale/` entries — and nothing is compiled at install time, so no build approval step is involved. `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` are **peer dependencies** provided by the harness, so the plugin pulls in no second copy and has **no runtime dependencies** of its own; DSH's compatibility gate compares the `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer ranges against the running version and refuses to install on a mismatch.

> Mount the package exactly once. `dsh plugin add` records the row in `dsh.profile.bundles`; adding a second row for the same package in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` registers every tool name twice and fails at the loader.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper@latest   # upgrade
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper      # uninstall
```

Settings live in the profile, not in the package, so both commands leave them in place. The data directory (by default `$DSH_HOME/android-emulator-helper`, then `~/.dsh/android-emulator-helper`) holds screenshots and build logs; it is yours to delete, and uninstalling does not touch it.

The DSH compatibility range is **`>=0.2.1-rc.2`, a lower bound only**, declared identically in `peerDependencies`, `engines.dsh` and `dsh.compatibility.dsh`: a runtime below it is refused at install time, and no future harness release is excluded. The floor is the release this plugin's Plugins-page configuration was built and verified against.

One node-semver detail survives — a **new tuple's** prerelease such as `0.2.2-alpha.1` is not admitted by npm's and pnpm's default rules, so that install fails until either the range gains a branch for the tuple (`">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2-0 || >=0.2.2-0"`) or the peer check is skipped:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper \
  --config.strict-peer-dependencies=false
```
Stable releases at or above the floor (`0.2.1`, `0.3.0`, `1.0.0`, …) are unaffected and always admitted.

The settings namespace equals the profile patch row id equals `android-emulator-helper` (also `dsh.name`). The form registers with the Plugins page's `plugins.bundle.config` slot, keyed by the package name, so it renders inside the plugin's detail page in the Plugins panel instead of in the Settings dialog; it exists only while the host half serves that namespace. It reads and writes through `ctx.configForms`, so staged edits, dirty detection, inline validation, optimistic concurrency (revisions) and "overridden / reset to default" all come from the harness. The detail page draws the plugin's title, icon and description; the form contributes one line saying when an edit takes effect, one card per category — the card outline is what separates them — and saves from a sticky action bar at the bottom that appears only while there is something to act on: a staged edit, a write in flight, or a failure worth retrying.

- **Run diagnostic** → `GET /api/android-emulator-helper/status`, the same checks as `android_preflight`, each with its detail and fix hint.
- **Refresh devices and AVDs** → `GET /api/android-emulator-helper/inventory`, detecting the SDK root, the AVDs stored in the AVD directory (`ANDROID_AVD_HOME`, else `$ANDROID_USER_HOME/avd`, else `~/.android/avd`, merged with the names `emulator -list-avds` adds), connected devices, installed JDKs, system images, platforms and build-tools to populate the fields' suggestions. A record whose payload directory is gone is dropped from both sources. The scan is what lets the default-AVD dropdown list the machine's AVDs even when the emulator cannot be run.

The original plugin's `userConfig` — the seven variables in the last column above — still works as a fallback (last column above), so an existing ZCode or CI setup needs no change: the resolution order is configuration page → environment variable → declared default. The original also read `ANDROID_PLUGIN_DATA` for its data directory; here that directory is the page's `dataDir` field.

`screenshots.json` lists these four files in this order next to `package.json` in
the repository, which is how a plugin market finds them.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `android_preflight` | Check the SDK, `adb`, `emulator`, AVDs, Java, the Gradle project state and the UI backend, and echo the current settings. |
| `android_discover_project` | Find Gradle roots, modules, variants, application ids, manifests and APK outputs. |
| `android_create_app` | Generate a minimal Kotlin + Jetpack Compose project. |
| `android_build_app` | Build one module and variant with Gradle. |
| `android_build_and_run` | Build → reuse or start a device → install → launch the package read back from the built APK. |
| `android_list_devices` / `android_list_avds` | List the devices adb sees / the AVDs on this machine. |
| `android_start_emulator` / `android_stop_emulator` | Start a new GUI emulator / stop one by serial. |
| `android_create_avd` | Create an AVD with `avdmanager`. |
| `android_install_app` / `android_launch_app` / `android_terminate_app` | Install an APK / launch by application id / force-stop. |
| `android_open_url` | Open a URL on the device. |
| `android_screenshot` | Capture a PNG to disk, and return it as an image when the model accepts image input. |
| `android_logs` | Read the logcat tail, optionally filtered to the app'

`android_screenshot` deserves its own note: it always writes the PNG to disk
(under `<data dir>/screenshots/` by default) and additionally submits it to the
host's attachment service for a canonical image block. When the current model
declares no image input, or the deployment stores no attachments, the result
degrades to text plus the file path instead of failing the call.

- **`android-dev` skill** — shipped in `skills/android-dev/` and registered by the host half through `ctx.skills.register()` as an embedded skill with the skill directory as its `resourceBase`, so `INSTALL_ENVIRONMENT.md` keeps resolving. Rewritten for DSH: no `mcp__…` prefix, and environment configuration points at the plugin's configuration page rather than at environment variables.
- **`/android-dev [goal]` command** — registered through `ctx.commands.register()`. DSH user commands deliberately never create a model message, so this command does the one thing that is useful without the model: it runs the environment diagnostic and prints the verdict, the failing checks and their fixes.

| Aspect | Original (ZCode) | This plugin (DSH) |
|---|---|---|
| Tool exposure | stdio MCP server `android-emulator`; the model sees `mcp__android_emulator__*` | Native `ctx.tools.register()`; the model sees `android_*` |
| User configuration | `plugin.json` `userConfig` (7 items), injected as environment variables | Configuration page with 17 fields on a schemastery `Config`, all `.volatile()`; the old environment variables remain as fallbacks |
| Working directory | `process.cwd()` | `exec.agent.session.header.cwd` (the session workspace) |
| Data directory | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_DATA` / temp | `$DSH_HOME/android-emulator-helper`, configurable on the configuration page |
| Screenshot result | MCP image content (base64) | An image block built from a host attachment reference, degraded to text plus a disk path on refusal |
| Result normalisation | Providers return objects containing `undefined` | Every result passes through `toLosslessJson()` (the registry rejects `undefined`) |
| Slash command | Injects a prompt into the model's conversation | Runs the diagnostic and prints the verdict |
| Process invocation | `node:child_process` spawn | Unchanged |

The direct spawn is a deliberate trade-off: `gradlew`, `adb` and `emulator` behave byte-for-byte as they did in the original, and `adb exec-out` needs no binary-stream adapter; the cost is bypassing DSH's subprocess seam, so every call carries its own timeout and `SIGTERM` instead. The plugin reads and forwards no credential-bearing environment variables.

- **A machine with no global Gradle cannot build a generated project.** `android_create_app`
  writes no `gradlew`, and `android_build_app` can only generate one by running the
  `gradle` it finds on `PATH`; without one it fails with an explicit message. Install
  Gradle once, or run `gradle wrapper` in the project root yourself.
- **A generated project needs `compileSdk` 35 or newer.** The template pins
  `androidx.core:core-ktx` 1.15.0, whose `minCompileSdk` is 35; `android_create_app`
  refuses an older level instead of writing a project Gradle cannot configure.
- **A batch-file tool cannot carry an argument holding a defined `%NAME%` reference.**
  `gradlew.bat`, `avdmanager.bat` and any other `.bat`/`.cmd` launcher run through
  `cmd.exe`, which expands such a reference even inside quotes; the call refuses the
  argument instead of letting it be silently rewritten. A bare `%` — including the
  `%s` escapes `input text` sends for spaces — is safe.
- **Linux is unsupported**, exactly as in the original; `android_preflight` reports it.
- `android_start_emulator` always starts a new emulator and never reuses one. Pass `serial` to the other tools to reuse a target.

Every release is one commit in two places: tagged `vX.Y.Z` on `main` and published to npm from that tag, whose SHA npm records as `gitHead`. The list is at [Releases](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases) — [`v1.3.0`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.3.0) is the latest, after [`v1.2.0`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.2.0), [`v1.1.3`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.1.3), [`v1.1.2`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.1.2), [`v1.1.1`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.1.1), [`v1.1.0`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.1.0) and [`v1.0.0`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.0.0).

**Restart the DSH host process after upgrading.** The package is mounted as a `link:` symlink and Node caches ESM modules for the life of the process, so a change under `lib/` does not take effect until the host restarts — until then the tools keep serving the old code.

Issues and pull requests are welcome at [github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/issues). Every change has to keep `pnpm check` green — unit tests, a host/client consistency gate, a mount on a real Cordis host and a type check over both halves — and there is no CLA or form to fill in: a focused pull request that says what it changes and why is enough.

The package is shaped for the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) market. Development conventions — commands, repository map, invariants, testing, commit and release rules — live in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

把 ZCode 官方 `android-emulator@0.1.0` 插件移植为 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）原生插件**：原有 23 个 MCP 工具全部保留为 DSH 原生工具，并新增一个**参数表单**，渲染在「插件」页该插件的详情页里（插件 → 已安装插件 → Android 模拟器助手），让 SDK、模拟器、系统镜像、构建与输出目录等参数在应用里配置，而不是靠环境变量。

- 工具名、参数名与原插件完全一致，为原 `android_emulator` MCP 服务器写的工作流可直接迁移；这次移植既不新增工具，也不删除工具。
- 5 组 17 个设置项，全部实时生效；原插件暴露的 7 个字段仍会回落到同名 `ANDROID_PLUGIN_*` 变量，再回落到内置默认值。
- 默认 AVD 从下拉框里选，列出本机仍有 payload 的 AVD：AVD 探测既扫描 AVD 目录（`ANDROID_AVD_HOME`，否则 `$ANDROID_USER_HOME/avd`，否则 `~/.android/avd`），也询问 `emulator -list-avds`，因此即使 emulator 无法启动，列表依然可用。
- `android_preflight` 与参数页的 **检测环境** 按钮跑同一套检查——SDK、`adb`、`emulator`、AVD、JDK、Gradle——并逐条给出修复建议。
- 包名为 `@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper`；插件页显示的是 `locale/` 里的本地化名称 **Android Emulator Helper** / **Android 模拟器助手**，而不是原始包名，两条描述都写明本插件非官方、与 Google 无隶属关系。

在一台装有 Android SDK、JDK 与 DSH 的机器上：

1. **安装插件**

```bash
   dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper
   ```

DSH Desktop 则在 **插件** 页里添加同一个包名。装完重载或重启 DSH。

2. **检查本机环境** —— 打开 **插件 → 已安装插件 → Android 模拟器助手**，点 **检测环境**。它跑的就是 `android_preflight` 那套检查，缺什么都会给出修复建议。

3. **开始使用** —— 直接说你要什么（「把这个工程在模拟器上构建并运行」「给跑起来的应用截个图」），或直接调用 23 个 `android_*` 工具。工具需要的参数都能在那个页面里改。


**DSH Desktop**：`desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理——请在 **插件** 页里添加 `@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper`，并启用它创建的那一行。重载或重启后，打开 **插件 → 已安装插件 → Android 模拟器助手**：参数表单就在该插件的详情页里，且只有当 host 半侧真正提供该设置命名空间时它才会出现。

发布包内含插件需要的一切——host 半侧、浏览器 bundle、内置 skill 与 `locale/` 词条——且安装期不编译任何东西，因此没有构建审批环节。`@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 都是**由宿主提供的 peer 依赖**，插件不会带入第二份副本，本身**没有任何运行时依赖**；DSH 的兼容性闸门会拿 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 的 peer 区间与运行版本比对，不匹配直接拒装。

> 同一个包只能挂载一次。`dsh plugin add` 会把这一行记进 `dsh.profile.bundles`；再往 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里手加同一行，会让所有工具名二次注册并在加载期报错。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper@latest   # 升级
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper      # 卸载
```

设置保存在 profile 里而不是包里，所以这两条命令都不会动它。数据目录（默认 `$DSH_HOME/android-emulator-helper`，其次 `~/.dsh/android-emulator-helper`）存放截图与构建日志，卸载不会删除它，是否清理由你决定。

DSH 兼容范围是 **`>=0.2.1-rc.2`——只有下界，没有上界**，三处声明逐字一致（`peerDependencies`、`engines.dsh`、`dsh.compatibility.dsh`）：低于下界的运行时会**直接拒绝安装**，同时未来的稳定版都不会被排除。下界即本插件「插件」页配置所构建并验证过的版本。

只有一个 node-semver 细节绕不开：`0.2.2-alpha.1` 这类**新元组的预发布**在 npm/pnpm 的默认规则下不被放行，安装会失败。此时二选一——给范围补一条该元组的分支（`">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2-0 || >=0.2.2-0"`），或让 pnpm 放宽 peer 校验：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper \
  --config.strict-peer-dependencies=false
```
稳定版中不低于下界的版本（`0.2.1`、`0.3.0`、`1.0.0`…）不受这个细节影响，一律放行。

配置命名空间 = profile patch 行 id = `android-emulator-helper`（同时是 `dsh.name`）。表单注册到插件页的 `plugins.bundle.config` 槽、以包名为键，因此渲染在「插件」页该插件的详情页里，而不是「设置」对话框里；只有当 host 半侧提供该命名空间时它才存在。表单通过 `ctx.configForms` 读写，因此暂存编辑、脏值检测、内联校验、乐观并发（revision）与「已覆盖 / 恢复默认」语义都由 harness 提供。详情页负责绘制插件标题、图标与描述；表单本身只贡献一行「改动何时生效」的说明、每个分组一张卡片——卡片描边就是分组之间的分隔——以及底部粘性保存栏；保存栏只在有可操作内容时出现：有暂存改动、正在写入，或一次失败值得重试。

| 分组 | 设置项 | 类型 | 默认值 | 旧环境变量回落 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SDK 与工具链 | `sdkPath` | 文本 | 空（自动探测） | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_SDK_PATH` |
| | `jdkMajor` | 文本，建议来自本机 | `17` | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_JDK_MAJOR` |
| | `buildToolsVersion` | 文本，建议来自本机 | `35.0.0` | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_BUILD_TOOLS_VERSION` |
| 模拟器与设备 | `defaultAvd` | 下拉（`discovery`），列出本机所有 AVD | `medium_phone` | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_DEFAULT_AVD` |
| | `defaultSerial` | 文本，建议来自本机 | 空 | — |
| | `autoStartEmulator` | 开关 | 开 | — |
| | `emulatorArgs` | 多行文本，每行一个参数 | 空 | — |
| | `bootTimeoutSeconds` | 整数 | `180` | — |
| API 与系统镜像 | `apiLevel` | 文本，建议来自本机 | `35` | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_API_LEVEL` |
| | `systemImageVariant` | 下拉 | `default` | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_SYSTEM_IMAGE_VARIANT` |
| | `systemImageAbi` | 下拉（留空 = 宿主架构） | 自动 | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_SYSTEM_IMAGE_ABI` |
| | `minSdk` | 整数 | `23` | — |
| 构建 | `buildTimeoutSeconds` | 整数 | `600` | — |
| | `gradleExtraArgs` | 多行文本 | 空 | — |
| 输出目录与日志 | `dataDir` | 文本 | `$DSH_HOME/android-emulator-helper` | — |

配置页的两个按钮调用 host 半侧的两个精确 Fetch 路由：

- **检测环境** → `GET /api/android-emulator-helper/status`，返回与 `android_preflight` 相同的检查结果，逐条显示状态、详情与修复建议。
- **刷新设备与 AVD** → `GET /api/android-emulator-helper/inventory`，探测 SDK 根目录、AVD 目录（`ANDROID_AVD_HOME`，否则 `$ANDROID_USER_HOME/avd`，否则 `~/.android/avd`）里的 AVD 并与 `emulator -list-avds` 给出的名字合并、已连接设备、已安装 JDK、已装系统镜像/platform/build-tools，用于填充上方字段的建议列表。payload 目录已不存在的记录在两个来源里都会被剔除。正是这次扫描让默认 AVD 下拉框在 emulator 无法运行时也能列出本机 AVD。
原插件的 `userConfig`——也就是上表最后一列的 7 个变量——仍会作为回落生效，所以已有的 ZCode 或 CI 环境无需改动：解析顺序为配置页 → 环境变量 → 内置默认值。原插件的数据目录读的是 `ANDROID_PLUGIN_DATA`；在本插件里，这个目录就是配置页的 `dataDir` 字段。

`screenshots.json` 就在仓库里的 `package.json` 旁边按这个顺序列出四张图，插件市场据此展示。

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `android_preflight` | 检查 SDK、`adb`、`emulator`、AVD、Java、Gradle 工程状态与 UI 自动化后端，并回显当前设置。 |
| `android_discover_project` | 发现 Gradle 根、模块、variant、applicationId、manifest 与 APK 产物。 |
| `android_create_app` | 生成最小 Kotlin + Jetpack Compose 工程。 |
| `android_build_app` | 用 Gradle 构建指定模块与 variant。 |
| `android_build_and_run` | 构建 → 复用或启动设备 → 安装 → 启动（启动的包名从构建出的 APK 读回）。 |
| `android_list_devices` / `android_list_avds` | 列出 adb 可见设备 / 本机 AVD。 |
| `android_start_emulator` / `android_stop_emulator` | 启动新的 GUI 模拟器 / 按序列号停止模拟器。 |
| `android_create_avd` | 用 `avdmanager` 创建 AVD。 |
| `android_install_app` / `android_launch_app` / `android_terminate_app` | 安装 APK / 按 applicationId 启动 / 强制停止应用。 |
| `android_open_url` | 在设备上打开 URL。 |
| `android_screenshot` | 截图并落盘；模型支持图像输入时同时返回图像。 |
| `android_logs` | 读取 logcat 尾部，可过滤到应用自身进程（按 PID）。 |
| `android_ui_status` | 探测并报告设备端 UI 自动化可用性。 |
| `android_ui_describe` / `android_ui_resolve` | 返回 UI Automator 元素树 / 按文本、描述、资源 id 或类名解析到坐标。 |
| `android_ui_tap` / `android_ui_swipe` / `android_ui_type_text` / `android_ui_keyevent` | 基于 adb 的点击、滑动、文本输入与按键事件。 |
`android_screenshot` 的行为值得单独说明：PNG 总会写到磁盘（默认在数据目录的 `screenshots/` 下），同时尝试把图像提交给宿主的附件服务以获得规范的图像块。当前模型未声明图像输入、或部署没有附件服务时，结果会退化为纯文本并附上文件路径，而不会让整次调用失败。

- **`android-dev` skill** —— 随包提供（`skills/android-dev/`），host 半侧通过 `ctx.skills.register()` 注册为嵌入式 skill，并把 skill 目录作为 `resourceBase`，因此 `INSTALL_ENVIRONMENT.md` 的相对引用照旧可用。内容已按 DSH 改写：不再有 `mcp__…` 前缀，环境配置指向插件配置页而不是环境变量。
- **`/android-dev [目标]` 命令** —— 通过 `ctx.commands.register()` 注册。DSH 的用户命令刻意不产生模型消息，因此该命令做一件不依赖模型的事：跑一遍环境诊断，输出结论、失败项与修复建议。

| 方面 | 原插件（ZCode） | 本插件（DSH） |
|---|---|---|
| 工具暴露 | stdio MCP 服务器 `android-emulator`；模型看到 `mcp__android_emulator__*` | 原生 `ctx.tools.register()`；模型看到 `android_*` |
| 用户配置 | `plugin.json` 的 `userConfig`（7 项），经环境变量注入 | 配置页 + schemastery `Config` 的 17 个字段，全部 `.volatile()`；旧环境变量仍作回落 |
| 工作目录 | `process.cwd()` | `exec.agent.session.header.cwd`（会话工作区） |
| 数据目录 | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_DATA` / 临时目录 | `$DSH_HOME/android-emulator-helper`，可在配置页配置 |
| 截图返回 | MCP image content（base64） | 由 host 附件引用生成的图像块，被拒时退化为文本 + 磁盘路径 |
| 结果归一 | provider 返回含 `undefined` 的对象 | 所有结果都过一遍 `toLosslessJson()`（注册表拒绝 `undefined`） |
| 斜杠命令 | 向模型对话注入一段提示词 | 直接运行诊断并输出结论 |
| 进程调用 | `node:child_process` 直接 spawn | 保持一致 |
保留直接 spawn 是有意的取舍：这样 `gradlew`、`adb`、`emulator` 的行为与原插件逐字节一致，也不必为 `adb exec-out` 的二进制流另写适配层；代价是绕过了 DSH 的 subprocess seam，因此每个外部调用都自带 timeout 与 `SIGTERM`。插件不读取、不转发任何含凭据的环境变量。

- **本机没有全局 Gradle 时，生成的工程无法构建。** `android_create_app` 不写 `gradlew`，
  而 `android_build_app` 只能借助 `PATH` 里的 `gradle` 生成 wrapper；没有就会明确报错。
  请先装一次 Gradle，或自己在工程根目录跑 `gradle wrapper`。
- **生成的工程要求 `compileSdk` 不低于 35。** 模板锁定 `androidx.core:core-ktx` 1.15.0，
  其 `minCompileSdk` 为 35；`android_create_app` 会拒绝更低的级别，而不是写出一个 Gradle
  无法配置的工程。
- **批处理工具的参数不能包含已定义的 `%NAME%` 变量引用。** `gradlew.bat`、`avdmanager.bat`
  等 `.bat`/`.cmd` 启动器都要经过 `cmd.exe`，后者即使在引号内也会展开这种引用；插件会拒绝
  该参数，而不是让它被静默改写。单独的 `%`（包括 `input text` 用来表示空格的 `%s`）是安全的。
- **Linux 不支持**，与原插件一致；`android_preflight` 会明确报告。
- `android_start_emulator` 永远启动新模拟器，从不复用已有目标（原插件语义）。复用请把 `serial` 传给其他工具。
- `android_create_avd` 对 `avdmanager` 的确认提示固定回答 `no`，绝不静默触发数 GB 的镜像下载；请先用 `sdkmanager` 装好镜像。
- UI 自动化依赖设备端的 `uiautomator`；不可用时 `android_ui_status` 会报告，构建 / 运行 / 截图链路不受影响。
- 配置页的「已安装系统镜像」列表来自 SDK 目录扫描，而不是 `sdkmanager --list_installed`（后者在受限环境下会失败，且输出夹带大量弃用提示）。
- 配置页的两条路由由插件提供并在真实 profile 中挂载，但它们的 HTTP 响应无法在 GUI 之外验证：桌面端对每个请求做鉴权，未带浏览器会话的 `curl` 访问 `/api/android-emulator-helper/status` 会在进入 handler 之前返回 `403 forbidden`。配置页的间距、暗色主题与窄屏换行仍建议在 GUI 中人工核对。
- 插件不触碰凭据：不读取、不转发任何含 key/token/secret 的环境变量。

每次发布都是同一个提交出现在两处：在 `main` 上打 `vX.Y.Z` 轻量 tag，并从该 tag 发布到 npm，npm 记录的 `gitHead` 就是它的 SHA。完整列表见 [Releases](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases)——最新是 [`v1.3.0`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.3.0)，之前是 [`v1.2.0`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.2.0)、[`v1.1.3`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.1.3)、[`v1.1.2`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.1.2)、[`v1.1.1`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.1.1)、[`v1.1.0`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.1.0) 与 [`v1.0.0`](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper/releases/tag/v1.0.0)。
